title: IdeaSynth: Iterative Research Idea Development Through Evolving and Composing Idea Facets with Literature-Grounded Feedback
focus_en: Lets users revise and combine an idea's problem, solution, evaluation, and contribution with feedback from the literature.
focus_zh: 让用户结合文献反馈，修改和组合研究想法中的问题、方案、评价与贡献。
boundary_en: User studies measure support for exploring and developing proposals; they do not demonstrate autonomous question selection or scientifically validated outcomes.
boundary_zh: 用户研究衡量的是探索与完善提案的支持效果，未证明自主选题能力或经过科学验证的研究成果。

title: CoQuest: Exploring Research Question Co-Creation with an LLM-based Agent
focus_en: Studies how breadth-first and depth-first question generation affect researchers' exploration, reflection, and control when working with an LLM.
focus_zh: 研究广度优先和深度优先的问题生成，如何影响研究者与 LLM 合作时的探索、反思和控制感。
boundary_en: Evidence concerns HCI researchers' ideation experience and perceived creativity; it does not establish the questions' eventual scientific importance or autonomous research success.
boundary_zh: 证据聚焦 HCI 研究者的构思体验与感知创造力，未建立问题的最终科学重要性或自主科研成功率。

title: Hypothesis Generation with Large Language Models
focus_en: Generates hypotheses from labeled examples. Uses prediction errors and bandit-inspired selection to expand and revise a hypothesis bank.
focus_zh: 从带标签样本生成假设，再利用预测错误和受 bandit 启发的选择机制，扩展与修正假设库。
boundary_en: Held-out predictive accuracy tests whether hypotheses capture useful dataset patterns; it does not establish causal explanations or the broader scientific importance of the questions.
boundary_zh: 留出集预测准确率检验假设能否捕捉有用的数据规律，不能证明因果解释或问题更广泛的科学重要性。

title: Literature Meets Data: A Synergistic Approach to Hypothesis Generation
focus_en: Combines knowledge from the literature with hypotheses generated and refined from data. Tests their predictions and their usefulness for human decisions.
focus_zh: 结合文献知识与从数据生成、修正的假设，测试预测效果及其对人类决策的帮助。
boundary_en: Evidence comes from classification and decision-support tasks, including deception and AI-content detection; predictive utility is not causal validation or open-ended scientific discovery.
boundary_zh: 证据来自欺骗检测、AI 内容检测等分类与决策辅助任务；预测效用不等于因果验证或开放式科学发现。

title: Large Language Models for Automated Open-domain Scientific Hypotheses Discovery
focus_en: Extracts backgrounds and inspirations from web texts, then uses several forms of feedback to generate and refine social-science hypotheses.
focus_zh: 从网页文本提取研究背景与启发，通过多种反馈生成和完善社会科学假设。
boundary_en: Expert and GPT-based judgments assess proposed hypotheses; judgments of novelty or plausibility do not substitute for experiments establishing that the hypotheses are true.
boundary_zh: 评价依赖专家与 GPT 对假设的判断；新颖性或合理性评价不能替代确认假设真实性的实验。

title: SciAgents: Automating Scientific Discovery Through Bioinspired Multi-Agent Intelligent Graph Reasoning
focus_en: Uses a knowledge graph and specialist agents to connect distant concepts, then generate, critique, and refine hypotheses across disciplines.
focus_zh: 用知识图谱和专家智能体连接不同领域的概念，再生成、批评和完善跨学科假设。
boundary_en: Demonstrations focus on bioinspired materials ideas; proposed mechanisms and predicted properties are starting points for research, not experimentally established discoveries or evidence of transfer to AI research.
boundary_zh: 展示主要聚焦仿生材料构思；提出的机制与预测性质是后续研究起点，不是经实验确认的发现，也未证明能迁移至 AI 研究。

title: IdeaBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Research Idea Generation
focus_en: Benchmarks idea generation from published papers' reference contexts and uses GPT-4o rankings to score selected criteria such as novelty and feasibility.
focus_zh: 以已发表论文的参考文献背景构造想法生成任务，并用 GPT-4o 的比较排序评价新颖性、可行性等指定维度。
boundary_en: Its relative scores measure judged proposal quality against a reference set; they do not demonstrate experimental success, causal validity, or realized scientific value.
boundary_zh: 相对分数衡量参考集合中被评审认可的提案质量，不能证明实验成功、因果有效性或已实现的科学价值。

title: Evaluating LLMs' divergent thinking capabilities for scientific idea generation with minimal context
focus_en: Asks models to generate scientific ideas from short keyword prompts. A changing LLM panel scores originality, feasibility, fluency, flexibility, and clarity.
focus_zh: 让模型根据简短关键词提出科学想法，由动态 LLM 评审团评价原创性、可行性、流畅性、灵活性和清晰度。
boundary_en: Brainstorming and judge ratings do not establish which questions are worth pursuing or yield discoveries; changing the judge panel also complicates comparisons over time.
boundary_zh: 头脑风暴与评审分数不能确认哪些问题值得投入或能带来发现；评审团变化也会增加跨时间比较的难度。

title: OpenNovelty: An LLM-powered Agentic System for Verifiable Scholarly Novelty Assessment
focus_en: Extracts a paper's contribution claims, searches prior work, and compares full texts to produce a novelty report with traceable evidence.
focus_zh: 提取论文的贡献主张，检索已有工作并比较全文，生成证据可追溯的新颖性报告。
boundary_en: Assesses novelty of supplied manuscripts rather than generating questions or estimating scientific importance; conclusions remain limited by retrieval coverage and model judgments.
boundary_zh: 评估的是给定论文的新颖性，不负责生成问题或估计科学重要性；结论仍受检索覆盖范围与模型判断限制。

title: InnoEval: On Research Idea Evaluation as a Knowledge-Grounded, Multi-Perspective Reasoning Problem
focus_en: Retrieves evidence and uses several reviewer perspectives to assess an idea's novelty, feasibility, and significance, with reasons for the judgments.
focus_zh: 检索证据，从多个评审视角判断想法的新颖性、可行性和重要性，并给出判断理由。
boundary_en: Agreement with human reviews tests the evaluator. It does not establish experimental success, long-term scientific value, or autonomous question selection.
boundary_zh: 与人类评审的一致性用于检验评审器，不能证明实验成功、长期科学价值或自主选题能力。
